docs.title: Retry configuration
docs.text: The SDK retry policy defaults to two retries. Set max_retries=0 to disable SDK retries when the application owns retries.

docs.title: Authentication
docs.text: Set the SUPPORT_API_KEY environment variable. Send it as a Bearer token in the Authorization header.

docs.title: Deployment rollback runbook
docs.text: Check the service and environment deployment record before proposing a rollback. This fixture system does not modify deployments.

docs.title: Pagination
docs.text: Use cursor pagination with limit at most 100. The next_cursor is null at the end.

docs.title: Cache TTL
docs.text: The documented default cache TTL is 300 seconds. Use cache_ttl_seconds to override it.
